response.overview: A duet for two eyes, just one at a time. Shot on a 1952 Stereo Realist and on a consumer 3D video camera made 70 years later. Hand processed, each eye numbered, taken apart and rebuilt a frame at a time. Made by hand. Sung at a distance. “The Happy Sunny Side of Life” (1936) counter melodies against despair.
response.title: but days pass like this
